oneOf.description: New camera leases refused; lower hints.
New camera and screen leases refused; lowest hints.

VideoCodec.description:
A video codec a client may publish under E2EE. There is no AV1 or H.265
value: they are never offered.

oneOf.description: VP9, only with the Dependency Descriptor (opt-in).

Vp9Hint.description: VP9 publishing rules when VP9 is configured.

requires_dd.description: Always `true`: the Dependency Descriptor is required.

description:
The client media policy: in join answers, `voice_server_updated`, READY
`install.media` and `media_policy_updated`.

backup_codec.description:
`true`: a native sender with OS H.264 may publish H.264 with a VP8 backup that the
engine turns on for subscribers without H.264. Browsers publish one codec. `true` only
while video is on and `codecs` lists both `vp8` and `h264` (in either order); `false`:
every client publishes one codec.

camera_allowed.description:
This session may hold a camera lease. `false` in a voice or call join answer when
the session's K2 pass has a `caps` claim without `voice:video`. Every other copy (READY
`install.media`, `media_policy_updated`, a move's `voice_server_updated`) says `true`,
so a client keeps its join answer's value for the whole join. Old payloads without it
read as `true`.

codecs.description: Video codecs in preference order (never AV1 or H.265; empty with video off).

relay_only.description:
The install is relay-only (`[voice] relay_only`, from
`voice.ops.ice_relay_only`): the engine's `JoinResponse` carries only the `turns:` URL and
`client_configuration.force_relay = ENABLED`, so a client gathers relay candidates only.
Sent only when `true`; absent reads as `false`.

screen_allowed.description: This session may hold a screen-share lease (as [`MediaPolicy::camera_allowed`]).

tier.description: The budget tier the hints are for.

vp9.description: VP9 rules, when VP9 is configured.
